questions.question: What do you think life will be like in 50 years?
questions.translation: كيف تعتقد أن الحياة ستكون بعد 50 سنة؟
suggested_answers: I think life will be very different because of new technology and robots.
In 50 years, medicine and transport will improve a lot and the environment will change.
Life will be easier and faster, with smart technology everywhere.

questions.question: What kind of house would you like to live in the future?
questions.translation: أي نوع من المنازل تريد أن تسكن في المستقبل؟
suggested_answers: I would like to live in a smart house with modern technology.
I would like a big, comfortable house with a nice design and smart systems.
In the future, I want to live in a modern house that uses technology to make life easier.

questions.question: What job would you like to have in the future? Why?
questions.translation: ما الوظيفة التي تريد أن تحصل عليها في المستقبل؟ لماذا؟
suggested_answers: I would like to be a doctor because I want to help people.
I want to be an engineer in the future because I like building things.
My dream job is to be a teacher because I want to help students learn.

questions.question: How will people travel in the future?
suggested_answers: People will travel in flying cars and very fast trains.
In the future, people may travel to space using rockets.
Travel will be faster and easier with new technology and modern transport.
